The vast majority of unindexed sites are mundane and not even worth seeing for the average internet user. Databases, pages not linked to by other pages, and pages that don't follow standard web protocol are obviously completely safe to view. The only reason illegal content is anywhere on the "deep web" is because people that desire a greater level of security or privacy generally don't want their sites to end up on search engines. Surprisingly enough, actual people doing actual illegal things aren't going to want normal people like you or me to be able to open up a browser and see everything they're doing by happenstance. The main reason to use a tor browser is privacy, and you won't find or do anything illegal unless you want to. Just getting tor and exploring is harmless- so have no fear of googling a list of .onion sites and checking out the hidden wiki.
Libraries of documents. Everything from how to deepthroat to making a fully automatic gun to full medical journals made by Nazis in the 1940s.

If by darknet you mean TOR, google "the hidden wiki." It's a repository of the major .onion urls. Wouldn't actually recommend messing around with TOR for that purpose (privacy, yes, poking around on sites that offer drugs, child porn, and hitmen -- or "hitmen" who are actually a CIA honeypot -- no.), but if you really want to mess around with it, there's your starting point.

Like some others said, darknet doesn't really exist in a way you might picture in your mind.

Think of the daknet similar to /b/ on 4chan, filled with scams, cp, gore, viruses, CIA Agents pretending to be hitmen, but- beyond all, it's mostly spam. A lot of the websites look like something made in 1995 (due to the super slow connections of tor). It isn't really some ominous place full of guilds of hackers, ebay listings of illegal drugs from sellers with 5 star ratings, etc, whatever you might imagine. Even if you wanted to buy something illegal, trying to even buy a bitcoin is a cluster fuck, let alone learning how it works.

The real communities of hackers, drugs and what not are more likely to be on IRC, just chatting. Most of the illegal crimes that occur on the Internet happen through private message on public websites. Hell, most illegal transactions and crimes happen through facebook messages honestly.
If your looking for info as well as the names of sites, the (uncensored) hidden wiki is pretty good. Ahmia.fi is a great for searching the darknet as well.
